description: Sort photos dropped on the Shoot Board into garment, avatar, location or reference (or unsure with two candidates) and report duplicates within the drop and in the library. Saves nothing. A photo the call had no time left for comes back with error deferred: send it again.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

files.description: Dropped photos, in drop order; results use the same index

file_name.description: Original file name, used only as a sorting hint

image_url.description: Public HTTP(S) URL of the uploaded image (host file download URL, or the image_url mcp_upload_intake_photo returned)

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file bytes, computed by the widget

name: mcp_intake_files
title: Sort Dropped Photos
